Resolves #22051
Related: #21358

Acquires `MainContainerController#openingCompanion` at entry to `onOpenSecondWindowClick()` inside a single `try/finally` block wrapping both the async `CompanionSurface.isWindowOpen(windowId)` focus branch and the `CompanionSurface.openWindow(me.component)` launch branch, preventing overlapping clicks from staging duplicate companion popups or wedging the lock on focus/rejection.

- **Change class (`pull-request-workflow.md §3.1`):** `restoration` (`fix`). `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` + `guards` run in CI.
- **Self-authored intake (`self-authored-carve.md`):** `Prescription checked: examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainerController.mjs — owns the concern`.

Evidence: L2 (local Playwright unit regression + Playwright Chromium multi-window repeat-focus E2E; full `e2e-engine` runs in CI) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3).

Micro-review eligible: contained — bounded reentrancy-guard lift inside `MainContainerController#onOpenSecondWindowClick` plus unit regression spec; touches no site outside `#22051`'s prescription and changes no rendered frame or wire contract.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/examples/stateProvider/AdvancedSurfaces.spec.mjs` (`Arm 1`: overlapping clicks while `isWindowOpen` is pending and resolves `false` -> `openCalls.length === 1`, `focusCalls.length === 0`) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/examples/stateProvider/AdvancedSurfaces.spec.mjs` (`Arm 2` & `Arm 3`: overlapping clicks while `isWindowOpen` resolves `true` -> `focusCalls.length === 1`, `openCalls.length === 1`; rejection in `isWindowOpen` releases `#openingCompanion` in `finally` so a settled follow-up click still focuses) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered + red-on-`dev` verified: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/examples/stateProvider/AdvancedSurfaces.spec.mjs` failed on unpatched `dev` (`e73de2efe1`) with `Expected length: 1, Received length: 2` (`openCalls`) and passes `3/3` on this branch |
